topic: US escalates sanctions on Iran's shadow banking networks

en.title: US sanctions over two dozen entities linked to Iran shadow banking networks
en.dek: Treasury targets exchange houses and front companies across UAE, Hong Kong, Singapore and Turkey
facts: US Treasury identified shadow banking hubs in UAE, Hong Kong and Singapore on 23 November 2026
More than 24 entities sanctioned including exchange houses and front companies
Networks facilitated $14.7 billion in activity between January 2025 and August 2026
Sanctions aim to disrupt Iran's access to foreign currency
Fox News reports Treasury gave Iran weeks before it had 'nothing left to trade'
Le Monde confirms new sanctions targeting alleged shadow banking network
body: On 23 November 2026 the US Treasury identified shadow banking hubs operating across multiple continents, primarily located in the UAE, Hong Kong, Singapore and Turkey according to the Treasury and Fox News.
The same day the Treasury sanctioned more than 24 entities, including exchange houses and front companies, to disrupt Iran's access to foreign currency as reported by Le Monde and The Jerusalem Post.
These networks facilitated $14.7 billion in activity between January 2025 and August 2026 according to the Treasury.
Fox News reported that Treasury Secretary Bessent gave Iran weeks before it had 'nothing left to trade' following the new sanctions.
Le Monde reported the measures target Iran's alleged 'shadow banking' network with new sanctions.
The Jerusalem Post confirmed US sanctions more than two dozen targets in Iran's shadow banking network.
Al Jazeera reported the US escalates sanctions on Iran, targeting 'shadow banking' networks.
Reuters reported US imposes sanctions on dozens linked to Iran's shadow banking networks earlier on 23 November 2026.
en.context: The United States has previously imposed sanctions on entities linked to Iran's financial infrastructure, with this latest action focusing on alleged shadow banking networks operating across Asia and the Middle East.

en.headline: US sanctions over two dozen entities linked to Iran shadow banking
en.body: The US Treasury Department sanctioned more than 24 entities, including exchange houses and front companies, to disrupt Iran's access to foreign currency. According to the Treasury, these networks facilitated $14.7 billion in activity between January 2025 and August 2026.

it.headline: Gli Stati Uniti sanzionano oltre due dozzine di entità legate al sistema bancario ombra iraniano
it.body: Il Dipartimento del Tesoro degli Stati Uniti ha sanzionato più di 24 entità, tra cui case di cambio e società di facciata, per ostacolare l'accesso dell'Iran alle valute estere. Secondo il Tesoro, queste reti hanno facilitato attività per 14,7 miliardi di dollari tra il gennaio 2025 e l'agosto 2026.

de.headline: US-Sanktionen gegen über zwei Dutzend mit Iran verbundene Schattenbanken
de.body: Das US-Finanzministerium sanktionierte über 24 Einheiten, darunter Wechselstuben und Briefkastenfirmen, um Irans Zugang zu Fremdwährungen zu unterbinden. Laut Finanzministerium ermöglichten diese Netzwerke Aktivitäten in Höhe von 14,7 Milliarden US-Dollar zwischen Januar 2025 und August 2026.

fr.headline: Sanctions américaines contre deux douzaines d'entités liées à la banque parallèle iranienne
fr.body: Le Trésor américain a sanctionné plus de 24 entités, y compris des maisons de change et des sociétés écrans, afin de perturber l'accès de l'Iran aux devises étrangères. Selon le Trésor, ces réseaux ont facilité 14,7 milliards de dollars d'activités entre janvier 2025 et août 2026.

es.headline: Sanciones estadounidenses a más de dos docenas de entidades vinculadas a la banca en la sombra de Irán
es.body: El Departamento del Tesoro de EE. UU. sancionó a más de 24 entidades, incluyendo casas de cambio y empresas fachada, para interrumpir el acceso de Irán a divisas extranjeras. Según el Tesoro, estas redes facilitaron 14.700 millones de dólares en actividad entre enero de 2025 y agosto de 2026.

pt.headline: Sanções dos EUA a mais de duas dezenas de entidades ligadas ao sistema bancário paralelo do Irão
pt.body: O Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA sancionou mais de 24 entidades, incluindo casas de câmbio e empresas de fachada, para perturbar o acesso do Irão a moeda estrangeira. Segundo o Tesouro, estas redes facilitaram 14,7 mil milhões de dólares em atividade entre janeiro de 2025 e agosto de 2026.

zh.headline: 美国对与伊朗影子银行相关的二十多家实体实施制裁
zh.body: 美国财政部对包括兑换所和空壳公司在内的24多个实体实施了制裁，以切断伊朗获取外汇的渠道。财政部称，这些网络在2025年1月至2026年8月期间促成了147亿美元的活动。

ja.headline: イランのシャドーバンキングに関連する24以上の組織に対する米制裁
ja.body: 米国財務省は、イランの外国通貨へのアクセスを妨害するため、両替商やフロント企業を含む24以上の組織に制裁を科しました。財務省によると、これらのネットワークは2025年1月から2026年8月の間に147億ドルの取引を円滑化していました。

ko.headline: 이란 그림자 금융과 연루된 20여 개 단체에 대한 미국의 제재
ko.body: 미국 재무부는 이란의 외화 접근을 차단하기 위해 환전소 및 위장 회사를 포함한 24개 이상의 단체에 제재를 가했습니다. 재무부에 따르면, 이 네트워크들은 2025년 1월부터 2026년 8월 사이에 147억 달러 규모의 활동을 지원했습니다.

en.headline: US Treasury identifies shadow banking hubs in UAE, Hong Kong and Singapore
en.body: The US Treasury reported that the targeted financial networks operate across multiple continents. These entities are primarily located in the UAE, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Turkey, according to the Treasury and reports from Fox News.

it.headline: Il Tesoro USA identifica hub del sistema bancario ombra negli Emirati Arabi Uniti, a Hong Kong e a Singapore
it.body: Il Dipartimento del Tesoro degli Stati Uniti ha riferito che le reti finanziarie colpite operano in diversi continenti. Secondo il Tesoro e i rapporti di Fox News, tali entità si trovano principalmente negli Emirati Arabi Uniti, a Hong Kong, a Singapore e in Turchia.

de.headline: US-Finanzministerium identifiziert Schattenbank-Zentren in VAE, Hongkong und Singapur
de.body: Das US-Finanzministerium berichtete, dass die betroffenen Finanznetzwerke auf mehreren Kontinenten operieren. Laut Finanzministerium und Berichten von Fox News befinden sich diese Einheiten hauptsächlich in den VAE, Hongkong, Singapur und der Türkei.

fr.headline: Le Trésor américain identifie des pôles de banque parallèle aux Émirats arabes unis, à Hong Kong et à Singapour
fr.body: Le Trésor américain a indiqué que les réseaux financiers visés opèrent sur plusieurs continents. Ces entités sont principalement situées aux Émirats arabes unis, à Hong Kong, à Singapour et en Turquie, selon le Trésor et des rapports de Fox News.

es.headline: El Tesoro de EE. UU. identifica centros de banca en la sombra en EAU, Hong Kong y Singapur
es.body: El Tesoro de EE. UU. informó que las redes financieras objetivo operan en múltiples continentes. Estas entidades se encuentran principalmente en los EAU, Hong Kong, Singapur y Turquía, según el Tesoro y reportes de Fox News.

pt.headline: Tesouro dos EUA identifica centros de banca paralela nos Emirados Árabes Unidos, Hong Kong e Singapura
pt.body: O Tesouro dos EUA reportou que as redes financeiras visadas operam em vários continentes. Estas entidades estão primariamente localizadas nos Emirados Árabes Unidos, Hong Kong, Singapura e Turquia, de acordo com o Tesouro e relatórios da Fox News.

zh.headline: 美国财政部确定阿联酋、香港和新加坡的影子银行中心
zh.body: 美国财政部报告称，这些目标金融网络跨越多个大洲运作。根据财政部和福克斯新闻的报道，这些实体主要位于阿联酋、香港、新加坡和土耳其。

ja.headline: 米財務省、UAE、香港、シンガポールにシャドーバンキングの拠点を確認
ja.body: 米国財務省は、標的とされた金融ネットワークが複数の大陸にわたって活動していると報告しました。財務省およびフォックスニュースの報道によると、これらの組織は主にUAE、香港、シンガポール、トルコに所在しています。

ko.headline: 미국 재무부, UAE, 홍콩, 싱가포르에 그림자 금융 허브 확인
ko.body: 미국 재무부는 표적이 된 금융 네트워크가 여러 대륙에 걸쳐 운영되고 있다고 보고했습니다. 재무부와 폭스뉴스 보도에 따르면, 이 단체들은 주로 UAE, 홍콩, 싱가포르, 터키에 위치하고 있습니다.
